name: Pitstop in Purgatory
source:
Dang, you're dead!

Astrid wakes up in Purgatory and has to make peace with her death. Only problem is... she doesn't remember anything! Point and click your way through adventure-based gameplay mixed with visual novel storytelling, and solve the mystery of our heroine's untimely demise.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2077080/Pitstop_in_Purgatory/]Steam[/url] and [url=https://tymedust.itch.io/pitstop-in-purgatory]Itch.io[/url]]
translation:
当当，你死定了！

阿斯特丽德在炼狱中醒来，必须接受自己的死亡。唯一的问题是……她什么都不记得了！通过点击与视觉小说故事讲述相结合的冒险游戏玩法，解开我们女主角英年早逝的谜团。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/2077080/Pitstop_in_Purgatory/]Steam[/url] 和 [url=https://tymedust.itch.io/pitstop-in-purgatory]Itch.io[/url]]
